---
title: Sudden shift in AI training
author: Marie-Hélène Burle
---

*Presented at the National Training Summit in Calgary, AB, in November 2026.*

:::{.def}

For years, our role was to help researchers utilize complex AI tools. Recently, however, there has been a sharp shift: while AI tools are now extremely easy to use, they are not so straightforward to use safely.

In this presentation, I outline the various AI webinars I have given over the years and contrast them with my most recent one on system hardening. Finally, I make the case for the creation of an AI safety committee.

:::
